issues.main_description_html:
Route: {{base_url}}/users/add-post
Current Route: /posts/add

Create API Add Post for Bypass Slim

  • Version 0
  • Version 1
  • Version 2

FOR BYPASS SLIM

  • Add Payload Status Post Visibility (Public, Unlisted, Private)

Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XEa0p1yuB7cRH9z42pQluFYV_EtkEqxpzV0yb8UROBQ/edit?tab=t.0

QA Summary - 31 July 2026

Result: Request failure observed; not marked Passed. Authenticated Dev requests for the documented v1 and v2 payload shapes successfully created a tester-owned Google Street View post and each was deleted immediately. The public-visibility default is consistent with the developer comment because this endpoint does not accept a visibility field. However, an authenticated form request with a missing body field returns HTTP 500 instead of a controlled validation response. Per QA classification, the observed HTTP 500 is recorded as a Request failure, not a coding Bug.

One v0 initialization draft was created for the version contract check. The API returned an opaque ID, but the documented draft-delete route returned 409 Post Not Found for that ID with the slim-ID query form. No published post or uploaded QA asset was left by the successful v1/v2 cases.

Developer Comment Coverage

Developer statement Verification Result
Visibility defaults to public at table level The bypass endpoint accepts no visibility input; valid v1/v2 requests completed successfully without a visibility field. Covered by API contract; direct database value requires DB access.

Test Environment and Data

Item Value
Environment Dev: https://app2-dev.panorra.com
Tester testergothru@gmail.com
Endpoint POST /posts/add
Valid post type gvt (Google Street View)
Public-safe URL https://example.com/qa-issue-128
Coordinate data -6.200000, 106.816666
Cleanup DELETE /posts/delete/{slug} after each successful v1/v2 creation

Real API Results

Scenario HTTP Response summary Result
No authorization, valid form shape 401 Unauthorized Pass
Authenticated request with no body form value 500 Empty response body Request failure
Authenticated v1 GVT create 200 Add Post Panorama Video Success; returned slug Pass; deleted with 200
Authenticated v2 GVT create 200 Add Post Panorama Video Success; returned slug Pass; deleted with 200
v0 initialization 200 { "version": 0, "sid": "<opaque-id>" } Init passed; cleanup route returned 409

Copyable Requests and Responses

Authentication (secret intentionally omitted):

POST https://app2-dev.panorra.com/auth
Content-Type: application/json

{"email_username":"testergothru@gmail.com","password":"<DEV_TESTER_PASSWORD>"}

Valid v1/v2 form request (replace v with 1 or 2):

POST https://app2-dev.panorra.com/posts/add
Authorization: <data.token>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

body={"v":"1","is_post":"gvt","category_id":"1","url":"https://example.com/qa-issue-128","little_planet":"false","animation":"false","description":"QA Issue 128 Dev","url_thumbnail":"","lat":"-6.200000","lng":"106.816666","pw":"true"}
{"statusCode":200,"data":{"valid":true,"messages":"Add Post Panorama Video Success","slug":"<generated-slug>"}}

Cleanup for a successful created post:

DELETE https://app2-dev.panorra.com/posts/delete/<generated-slug>
Authorization: <data.token>
{"statusCode":200,"data":{"valid":true,"messages":"Success Deleting Post","slug":"<generated-slug>"}}

Request-failure reproduction:

POST https://app2-dev.panorra.com/posts/add
Authorization: <data.token>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

body=

Observed: HTTP 500 with an empty response body. Expected: controlled HTTP 400 for missing or malformed body input.

Code Review Summary

Area Evidence Result
Route PostsRoutes.go registers POST /posts/add. Reachable
Request envelope AddPost reads form field body then unmarshals its JSON. Missing/malformed body maps to 500 instead of client validation
Version selection body.v == "0" uses the legacy panorama path; other values use the embed/GVT path. v1/v2 valid paths passed
GVT requirements GVT path requires category, URL, animation, little-planet, latitude, and longitude. Valid requests passed
Visibility No visibility field is parsed by this bypass handler. Consistent with default-table convention
Cleanup Published v1/v2 posts were deleted through /posts/delete/{slug}. Passed
v0 cleanup contract Init v0 returns an opaque ID; delete-draft with slim-ID form returned 409. Requires follow-up; temporary draft may remain

Test Method Matrix

Method Coverage Outcome
Black box Dev auth guard, missing body, v1/v2 valid creates, and cleanup. Two success paths; one request failure
Gray box Payload matched the handler's form-wrapped JSON contract and GVT requirements. Contract mismatch on missing body handling
White box Reviewed route, v0 branch, fallback branch, GVT validation, default visibility absence, and delete routes. Explains observed outcomes

Confusion Matrix

Actual request class Expected classification Observed classification Count
Valid authenticated v1/v2 requests Accepted and creatable HTTP 200, then deleted 2 true positives
Invalid unauthenticated request Rejected HTTP 401 1 true negative
Missing form body Controlled client rejection HTTP 500 1 false positive
Valid request rejected Rejected Not observed 0 false negatives

Developer Notes

No coding Bug is filed by this QA result. The HTTP 500 for a missing body field is classified as a Request failure under the project rule. Consider validating the form field before JSON unmarshal and returning a controlled HTTP 400; also reconcile the v0 opaque-ID response with the draft cleanup route so test drafts can be removed reliably.
